headline: US Lawmakers Consider New Restrictions on Nvidia Deals With China
summary: US lawmakers are preparing potential new export restrictions and investigations into Nvidia's commercial dealings in China following bipartisan calls in Washington.
why: Nvidia Corporation designs graphics processing units and AI hardware, serving as a pivotal hardware supplier for global technology and artificial intelligence development.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Potential US export restrictions could limit Nvidia's sales and market access in China.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Regulatory scrutiny and prospective US export limits on chip shipments to China threaten Nvidia's high-margin revenue stream in the Chinese market.
